subject: distributional determinantal point process
statement: The paper introduces the distributional determinantal point process (dDPP) as a novel repulsive point process whose atoms are probability distributions.

subject: L-ensemble concentration
statement: The paper derives concentration results for plug-in estimators of the L-ensemble, correlation kernel, and determinants given i.i.d. samples.

subject: Bayesian mixture model
statement: The paper proposes a distribution-valued random partition model via repulsive generalized Bayesian mixture with dDPP prior.

subject: decision-theoretic estimation
statement: The paper develops a decision-theoretic approach to report point estimate of mixing measure as Bayes rule under hierarchical optimal transport utility.

subject: symbolic regression
statement: The paper uses symbolic regression to discover explicit neural network weight-update rules outperforming hand-designed optimizers.

subject: optimizer discovery
statement: The paper reports discovered rules outperform best hyperparameter-tuned optimizer in 25 of 30 cases with aggregate 44.47% MSE reduction.

subject: LeAct framework
statement: The paper introduces LeAct, which recovers chain-of-thought reasoning from expert actions via latent-variable optimization.

subject: expert-iteration performance
statement: The paper shows LeAct is 5x closer to solver performance than strongest expert-iteration baseline at larger scale games.

subject: Flop Hold'em solving
statement: The paper reports LeAct wins head-to-head by +60 mbb/g at Flop Hold'em (~10^9 infosets).

subject: robotics policy learning
statement: The paper demonstrates LeAct is the only training recipe that improves on direct imitation for simulated robotics.

subject: DAGForge system
statement: The paper presents DAGForge, a browser-based system for authoring causal DAGs as auditable, evidence-linked artifacts.

subject: LLM-based causal judgment
statement: The paper uses LLM-based reasoning module to generate structured pairwise causal judgments grounded in verbatim evidence excerpts.

subject: DAG evaluation recall
statement: The paper achieves high edge recall on literature-based DAG cohort while retaining verifiable evidence trails absent from baselines.

subject: tabular scaling laws
statement: The paper presents 1,648 fitted power-law curves error(N) = a N^(-b) + c across 11,536 training runs on 18 datasets.

subject: power-law fit quality
statement: The paper reports power laws fit R^2 > 0.8 on 77.7% of cells, with tree ensembles dominating.

subject: exponent sharing
statement: The paper finds approximate shared exponents within model families with R^2 gap < 0.011, suggesting partial curve collapse.

subject: implementation variance
statement: The paper identifies replicator-implementation variance with mean CV(b) = 0.144 on fitted exponent despite fixed random seed.

subject: adapter necessity audit
statement: The paper introduces adapter necessity audit separating global, same-state, deployment, and allocation gain components.

subject: Go2 adaptation analysis
statement: The paper reports 5.2% same-state headroom but only 0.55% recovered allocation gain on Go2 locomotion.

subject: adapter utility decision
statement: The paper demonstrates at 1% thresholds, direct control queries return NO-GO decision under confirmatory audit.

subject: VRDQ algorithm
statement: The paper introduces VRDQ, an epoch-based distributed Q-learning algorithm for multi-agent reinforcement learning over networks.

subject: convergence with speedup
statement: The paper establishes high-probability finite-time convergence rates with linear speedups from agent collaboration.

subject: communication efficiency
statement: The paper proves linear speedups require only Õ(1) communication cost, substantially improving upon prior work.

subject: ResUNet for farmland
statement: The paper presents residual U-Net trained on 5,698 NAIP patches for farmland extent and boundary mapping.

subject: farmland segmentation metrics
statement: The paper reports test accuracy 0.8808, IoU 0.8605, Dice 0.9234, precision 0.8766, recall 0.9794 on farmland segmentation.

subject: SAM 3 fusion for refinement
statement: The paper shows fusion of ResUNet with frozen SAM 3 improved Dice from 0.858 to 0.955 on orchard rows.

subject: ISPCloak attack
statement: The paper proposes ISPCloak, optimization-free adversarial framework weaponizing ISP pipeline to mislead deepfake detectors.

subject: evasive adversarial examples
statement: The paper demonstrates embedding physical perturbations disrupts detection mechanisms, yielding universally evasive examples.

subject: medical image inpainting review
statement: The paper presents systematic review of 60 diffusion-based studies for medical image inpainting across imaging modalities.

subject: diffusion inpainting taxonomy
statement: The paper proposes taxonomy for diffusion-based approaches in medical image inpainting.

subject: dominant architectures
statement: The paper identifies denoising diffusion probabilistic models and latent diffusion as dominant inpainting architectures.

subject: inpainting challenges
statement: The paper highlights challenges including lack of standardized benchmarks and limited dataset diversity in evaluation.

subject: TRACE-RealWorld framework
statement: The paper addresses maintaining materialized views over changing physical worlds with costly, delayed, unreliable reads.

subject: validity abstraction
statement: The paper introduces commitment-level validity abstraction and consequence-conditioned adaptive view maintenance.

subject: transaction compensation
statement: The paper develops transaction-style, dependency-scoped compensation for commitments invalidated after authorization.

subject: provenance for replay
statement: The paper proposes append-only provenance supporting exact replay of world-model operations.

subject: interventional score geometry
statement: The paper develops interventional analogue of score-field geometry for identifying causal direction from observations.

subject: causal influence definition
statement: The paper defines causal influence via variation of interventional marginal distribution derivative.

subject: causal metric
statement: The paper introduces causal metric as Fisher information metric on intervention family with common target.

subject: identification dictionary
statement: The paper yields geometric dictionary clarifying what randomized trials, instrumental variables, and designs identify.

subject: MissHyper model
statement: The paper proposes MissHyper, missingness-guided hypergraph forecasting with pre-propagation synchronicity restoration.

subject: clinical forecasting performance
statement: The paper achieves consistent gains on PhysioNet 2012, MIMIC-III, and MIMIC-IV in multi-step clinical forecasting.

subject: component ablation
statement: The paper demonstrates snapshot restoration, adaptive fusion, and support-density encoding all contribute to improvements.

subject: RIS inference engine
statement: The paper introduces RIS (Reduced Interaction Sampling), model-agnostic architecture reducing attention complexity to O(N log N).

subject: long-context accuracy
statement: The paper reports RIS-Stochastic at 1% density achieves 75% accuracy at 32,768 tokens, outperforming dense baseline (72%).

subject: CPU-only deployment
statement: The paper demonstrates long-context inference runs on commodity CPU servers (16-128 GB RAM) without GPU acceleration.
